study: M8 team familiarity / repeat opportunity incremental AH payoff test
source_mode: Historical Crown event-path quotes; not actual HTTP-received prices except if explicitly matched in a separate receipt audit. Historical feature/score snapshots lack contemporaneous receipt proof for all prior team results, so results are time-ordered reconstruction, not live-as-of proof.
scope: Crown AH fixtures in saved path archive; unique FID; target outcomes and features restricted to 2019-2026 joined inventory; all candidate betting scores exclude frozen eight FIDs; prior outcomes may use only earlier fixtures at least 72 hours before target.
question: Do prior observed team fixture counts, prior within-league exposure, head-to-head repeats, or 365-day exposure add forward predictive value beyond the same historical Crown market-path inputs?
novelty_vs_prior: Earlier M8 rounds tested team scoring/defense/shot residuals, transfers, lineups, managers, absences, opponent-email identity, market-only path Ridge, and market timing. This tests exposure/familiarity counts and repeated-opponent counts as information-volume predictors; it does not repeat the prior team strength residual or add new market-only Ridge tuning.
settlement: Quarter-line Asian handicap split into two half-stakes; away margin uses - (home goal difference + home AH line). One unit per selected fixture.

feature_definition.exposure_counts: prior joined fixtures through target UTC kickoff minus 72 hours; all competitions and same-league counts
feature_definition.head_to_head: prior joined matches between the same mapped team IDs through target UTC kickoff minus 72 hours
feature_definition.last365: same prior fixture counts in preceding 365 days
feature_definition.training: expanding calendar-year; test 2024 fits 2019-2023, 2025 fits through 2024, 2026 fits through 2025; alpha=100 ridge on standardized features; fit side-specific realized Crown AH returns
feature_definition.action: per unique FID select higher predicted side only if predicted net return > 0, else abstain; research-only; no posthoc target-year tuning

actual_receipt_validation.reason: Independent team history records do not carry contemporaneous receipt/availability timestamps; historical model target price/path is event-time T1, while live receipt snapshots use different T horizons. No horizon-matched, time-stamped training+features were available; no substitute quote used.
